paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Zohar, Yitro 80a.

notes.text: The supplied locator זהר יתרו פ.. is rendered Zohar, Yitro 80a. The mention of Rabbi Chiyya son of Rabbi Yose at that folio remains unverified.
The earlier Zohar lookup resolved the requested folio to the whole Yitro parashah. That addressing limitation must be distinguished from a verified folio-level nonmatch.

The folio-labelled text of Zohar II 80a has Rabbi Yose narrate that “Rabbi Chiyya, my son, was with me” (רבי חייא ברי עמי) when he encountered a man gathering herbs. He later addresses Chiyya as “my son” again. The corresponding paragraph in the vocalized Yitro text uses the same first-person relation. This is the local wording behind Hyman’s heading.
